summary: Verification-and-gap-closure plan for the system-defect discrimination contract. Both file_scope deliverables were already written and committed by the research phase; all 20 verifiable claims in them (line citations, cross-references, index registration, task-reference lint, JSON validity) were independently re-checked and hold. Three genuine gaps found in the markdown deliverable, one substantive: Signal A's ARTIFACTS_SHAPE_MISMATCH wording provably excludes a null/absent artifacts field on a success status, and the live detector fires on neither arm for that case (verified empirically) — the exact defect observed this run as a planner handoff with artifacts: null. Also: the handoff-present branch has no artifacts shape check at all, so that class is undetected rather than detected-and-discarded; a citation range is off by two lines; and two orchestrator-load-bearing scripts are neither added to nor excluded from critical_paths with reasoning. 4 sequential phases, 2.0 hours. The JSON deliverable needs no change and the task's own scope boundary (no recorder, no wiring, no command change) is preserved.
